trening.title: Daily training
trening.text: Every day you get a ready plan. Tick off your training and rack up points.

areny.title: Climb through the arenas
areny.text: Your activity drives your score and XP. Rank up through the arenas.

klub.title: Clubs & matches
klub.text: Build a squad and play matches. You earn XP for games you play, too.

kotc.title: King of the Court
kotc.text: Win pickup games back-to-back and become king of the court.

start.title: This is your time
start.text: You're all set. Jump on the court.
